name: Shiki Haruya
source: Shiki Haruya is a prominent member of underground organization Awakusu-kai. He frequently asks Celty and Shinra to do jobs as a favor to him and is the person responsible for dealings with Orihara Izaya. He relies less on violent methods and more on information and financial manipulation.
translation: Shiki Haruya is a prominent member of underground organization Awakusu-kai. He frequently asks Celty and Shinra to do jobs as a favor to him and is the person responsible for dealings with Orihara Izaya. He relies less on violent methods and more on information and financial manipulation.
